title: WhatsApp Marketing Messages | Boost customer engagement and sales

facts.fact: WhatsApp's marketing message category is described as promotional messages that drive interest, conversion, and re-engagement with customers.
facts.quote: Engage customers and build loyalty throughout the customer journey by driving interest, conversion, and re-engagement with promotional WhatsApp marketing messages.

facts.fact: According to the vendor, WhatsApp Business Platform is aimed at medium to large businesses.
facts.quote: WhatsApp Business Platform empowers medium to large businesses to scale customer engagement, boost sales, and create a better customer experience with full-funnel interactions.

facts.fact: The vendor states that a business can start personalized awareness marketing messages only after customers opt in to receive WhatsApp messages from it.
facts.quote: Once they opt in to receive WhatsApp messages from you, you can start personalized marketing messages to build awareness.

facts.fact: The vendor says re-engagement marketing messages are used to revive dormant customers who previously visited a website or used an app.
facts.quote: Use marketing messages to revive dormant customers who visited your website or used your app in the past.

facts.fact: The vendor lists reviving an abandoned cart and renewing a lapsed subscription among re-engagement marketing message use cases.
facts.quote: Revive an abandoned cart Renew a lapsed subscription Share loyalty offers Upsell products or services

facts.fact: The vendor says drive-sales marketing messages are used to announce deals or share promotions and coupons.
facts.quote: Spark sales with messages that announce deals or share promotions and coupons.

facts.fact: The vendor lists following up on Ads That Click to WhatsApp as a use of awareness marketing messages.
facts.quote: Follow-up on your Ads That Click to WhatsApp

facts.fact: The vendor gives a birthday discount code as an example of a message used to build customer relationships.
facts.quote: Demonstration of a business building a relationship with a customer with a birthday discount code
